messages:
josh (support): FYI customer on Dedicated is hitting a weird pattern: requests time out client-side (AbortError) but our logs show the server still processed them and the SDK retried, causing duplicate work. sending logs and repro steps from customer.

linda (support): Customer reports Node TS SDK v1.4.2, undici 5.23.0, Node 18.16.0. They use AbortController with a 1s timeout.

maria (eng-runtime): interesting. do we have a correlation id/x-request-id for one of the failed attempts? need to check whether the retry loop respects AbortSignal.

josh (support): got one from customer: x-request-id: req_01F8W3X4YCDK0. logs: 
```
[2026-01-28T15:04:12.123Z] incoming request POST /v1/generate id=req_01F8W3X4YCDK0 status=200 duration=742ms
[2026-01-28T15:04:12.130Z] client-side aborted signal id=req_01F8W3X4YCDK0 reason=timeout
[2026-01-28T15:04:13.000Z] retry attempt=1 id=req_01F8W3X4YCDK0 try_id=req_01F8W3X4YCDK0-1
```

josh (support): customer repro script: 
```
// repro.js
const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/inference');
const ac = new AbortController();
setTimeout(() => ac.abort(), 1000);
(async () => {
  const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
  try {
    await client.generate({ model: 'x-lite', prompt: 'hi' , signal: ac.signal});
  } catch (e) { console.error('err:', e.name, e.message); }
})();
```

maria (eng-runtime): thanks. is the SDK passing the AbortSignal down to undici.fetch or performing the retry loop outside of the fetch call? if retries are implemented at SDK level and abort only cancels current fetch, the retry loop could still kick off subsequent attempts.\
dave (sre): saw similar in past where undici 5 had subtle abort semantics on Node 18; undici 5 vs 6 changed behavior around destroying sockets vs aborting fetch. also confirm SDK's retry backoff: exponential with jitter and a max of 3 attempts?\
linda (support): From customer: retries: default, backoff 300ms -> 900ms -> 2700ms. They see abort after 1s so second retry triggers after abort.\
undici-bot: note: undici fetch will forward AbortSignal to the request, but if higher-level code wraps fetch in a retry, abort must be checked at retry entry.\
maria (eng-runtime): action plan: 1) reproduce locally with node 18 and 20 and undici pinned to 5.23.0 and 6.x 2) add instrumentation to SDK retry loop to bail out if signal.aborted 3) if repro, patch to check signal before scheduling next attempt.\
josh (support): i reproduced locally with their script. behavior summary: first attempt runs ~740ms, abort fires at ~1000ms, SDK logs "attempt failed, scheduling retry" and starts a new attempt at ~1300ms. so yes retry loop ignores aborted signal between attempts.\
maria (eng-runtime): thanks. sounds like a bug in SDK retry logic. quick fix: before starting an attempt, check if signal && signal.aborted then throw AbortError. I'll open a PR to add that and add unit test. patch will be minimal.\
dave (sre): short-term workaround for customers: either set retries:0 in client config or increase abort timeout > max backoff window, or pin undici version to 6.x where abort timing may be different. But recommend patch.\
josh (support): customer is on Dedicated and worried about duplicate billing for duplicate requests. also they said some retries hit rate limits and return 429 -> more retries. urgent ask to avoid retries after abort.\
maria (eng-runtime): will target a patch release in the next 24-48h. PR includes: check signal.aborted before each attempt, pass signal into underlying fetch, and add an integration test with fake clock to simulate abort during wait.\
linda (support): copying customer: we can apply temporary config (retries:0) or upgrade Node/undici. asking engineering for a clear rollback path if patch regresses.\
maria (eng-runtime): we'll keep default behavior. patch is just a guard; shouldn't change normal retry semantics. i'll add a feature flag 'strictAbort' for quick toggling in case.\
dave (sre): also log a field retry_bailed_due_to_abort=true so we can filter incidents and confirm customers stop seeing duplicates. add metric.\
josh (support): thanks. i'll send customer repro instructions and the workaround. will update once they confirm. :thumbsup:\
maria (eng-runtime): PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra-sdk/pull/489 (draft). test added. assigning to @maria for review and @dave for perf check.\
josh (support): customer confirmed workaround (retries:0) removed duplicates, billing concern eased. waiting for patch release.\
linda (support): great. mark as escalated->resolved once release shipped.\
maria (eng-runtime): merged, rollout plan: patch to npm @redwood/inference v1.4.3, staged deploy to Hosted first, then push to Dedicated and Private. release notes will mention fixing retry behavior with AbortSignal.\
josh (support): closing loop with customer now. thanks team. :rocket:
